So, what would I recommend to anyone having similar suicidal thoughts? Well instead of me recommending drugs like Luvox I would suggest the acceptance and commitment therapy first. The gist of the therapy is that we all experience psychological pain but the logical solution to it is actually not the correct one. It is logical to avoid pain at all costs, it is what any animal would try to do. The problem with psychological pain is that, by avoiding it you actually make it worse.

For example, lets say I have depression and I feel like shit and don't want to do anything. This feeling of depression is called the pain of presence. It is what you feel currently. However, if you don't feel like doing something like going outside for a walk and instead choose to avoid doing this activity this is called the pain of avoidance. This is a very logical thing to do. Avoiding the discomfort of trying to go for a walk because 'you won't enjoy it' or 'what is the point' will just further contribute to your current depression.

So this kind of therapy teaches you to accept your pain and be willing to fully experience it. I accepted my suicidal thoughts and all the pain that I have been in for many years and who knows what helped more, the therapy or the meds, but I don't think about killing myself anymore.
